edits.old: And the run fails when any of these is broken, with the schema, the statement or the call chain named
edits.new:
And the run fails when any of these is broken, with the schema, the statement or the call chain named

  Scenario: AC8 The realignment rules BR6 to BR9 hold in the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    When the trace of the run is checked
    Then the ACE holding is read only through the contract of rwb-source-data (BR6)
    And the masking decision is returned by rwb-access and not computed in rwb-integration (BR7)
    And the freshness stamp is taken from the freshness answer of rwb-source-data (BR8)
    And the product-group map, the product-status list and the party roles are read through the reference-data contract of rwb-case (BR9)

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed event delivered twice changes no answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consumed event "Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-ITG-E2003-ITG-AC9)" is delivered twice to the same consumer
    When the second delivery is processed
    Then the answer for "RW-2026-000410" is the same as after the first delivery
    And the event is not applied twice

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a change of product status that the status model does not allow is requested
    When the harness requests the change for "RW-2026-000410"
    Then the change is refused with "Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-ITG-E2003-ITG-AC10)"
    And the product status is unchanged
